title: ADF Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Agentic Development Framework adf-config.json files

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocompletion

privacyBlock.description: Enable privacy block hook to protect sensitive files (.env, credentials, etc.)

mode.description: strict asks as configured. auto turns every ask into an allow (git.enforcement ask runs as off, privacy-block does not ask, AskUserQuestion is refused with a decide-and-record instruction) and never weakens a deny. ADF_MODE in the environment overrides it for one session; /adf-mode switches it

modeRestore.description: Written by /adf-mode auto when settings.local.json already had a permissions.defaultMode, so /adf-mode strict can put it back. Not meant to be edited by hand

maxLoc.description: Maximum lines of code per documentation file

legacyLayoutNotice.description: Show a session-start note while the project still uses the old flat docs layout. Set false to hide it, for example when docs/ is a documentation site.

namingFormat.description: Format for plan directory names. Variables: {date}, {issue}, {slug}

dateFormat.description: Date format for plan names (moment.js format)

issuePrefix.description: Prefix for issue references (e.g., GH-, JIRA-). null=no prefix

reportsDir.description: Subdirectory name for reports within plans

order.description: Order of resolution strategies for plan context

branchPattern.description: Regex pattern to extract plan slug from branch name

mode.description: Validation mode: prompt=ask questions, auto=auto-validate, off=skip (none is a legacy alias of off), strict=require all

docs.description: Docs root: a relative folder inside the project (not ".", ".git" or ".claude"); other values fall back to "docs"

enabled.description: Whether trust mode is currently enabled

type.description: Project type (auto=detect from repo files). application, cli, api, web and mobile are accepted for older configs and behave like single-repo

model.description: Gemini model to use for CLI commands

useGemini.description: Use Gemini CLI for research (opt-in: true only with a working Gemini CLI; false=use WebSearch)

pattern.description: Glob pattern or regex for files to match

assertions.description: Code assertions and rules to enforce

statusline.description: Statusline display mode: full=all features, compact=2-3 lines, minimal=single text line, none=disabled

hooks.description: Toggle individual hooks on/off. Default: all enabled. Set a hook to `false` to disable; only explicit `false` disables (undefined/null/missing keys default to enabled).

session-init.description: SessionStart hook - project detection and env setup

subagent-init.description: SubagentStart hook - injects context to subagents

descriptive-name.description: PreToolUse hook - descriptive name for scripts

dev-rules-reminder.description: UserPromptSubmit hook - injects dev rules context

context-tracking.description: Reserved: gates the context-window section of dev-rules-reminder, which is currently disabled in context-builder, so this has no effect yet

ask-gate.description: PreToolUse hook on AskUserQuestion - in auto mode refuses the question and tells Claude to decide and record; silent in strict mode

manifest-credential-redact.description: PostToolUse hook - masks credentials embedded in URLs (and npmrc/netrc/pypirc auth lines) in Read, Grep, Edit and narrowed Bash output before Claude sees them. Costs one node process per matched tool call; payloads without a URL and an @ exit immediately

simplify-gate.description: UserPromptSubmit hook - reminds about code-simplifier when a ship or commit verb appears while the working tree carries a large unsimplified diff; never blocks the prompt

workflow-artifact-gate.description: Opt-in UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse hook - validates fix/cook workflow artifacts before finalize and ship-like actions

session-state.description: Hook that persists and restores plan/session state across sessions

plan-format-kanban.description: Reserved toggle. The plan-format kanban hook does not currently read it; remove the hook from settings.json to disable

usage-context-awareness.description: Reserved: gates the usage-limit section of dev-rules-reminder, which is currently disabled in context-builder, so this has no effect yet (the statusline shows usage regardless)

cook-after-plan-reminder.description: Hook that reminds to run cook after a plan is created

team-context-inject.description: Hook that injects team context for teammate sessions

task-completed-handler.description: TaskCompleted hook - logs team task completions to the session's reports folder

commit-guard.description: PreToolUse hook - asks before a git commit records secrets; checks the commit message, commit -a, path types and direct commits on the main branch (see git and commitGuard)

git-flow-guard.description: PreToolUse hook - holds git add/push/tag and gh pr create/merge to the git workflow (see git); force-pushing a protected branch is always denied

verify-before-stop.description: PostToolUse + Stop hook - asks Claude to run a test, lint or build after editing code before it ends the turn

lint-on-edit.description: Async PostToolUse hook - lints the edited file with the project linter; also needs lintOnEdit.enabled=true

desktop-notify.description: Notification hook - desktop notification when Claude waits for the user

statuslineColors.description: Enable ANSI colors in the statusline. Set false for plain text.

statuslineQuota.description: Show the cosmetic 5h / wk quota chips in the statusline for native Claude subscription sessions. Disable to keep the layout without usage-window percentages.

statuslineLayout.description: Optional config-driven statusline layout. When absent, the built-in layout for the selected statusline mode is used.

baseMode.description: Base mode overriding statusline when a layout is set

sections.description: Legacy flat section list (use lines instead)

sectionConfig.description: Per-section options (e.g. color, label) keyed by section id

responsiveBreakpoint.description: Terminal width fraction below which the layout collapses

todoTruncation.description: Max characters of the current todo shown

simplify.description: Code-simplifier gate settings (UserPromptSubmit hook). Stateless — signals are recomputed live from `git diff HEAD`.

threshold.description: Diff-size limits that trigger the gate (live-computed per prompt).

locDelta.description: Total LOC added+removed across all files

singleFileLoc.description: Lines added in a single file

enabled.description: Master toggle. Off by default (opt-in). Set true to activate the gate; env ADF_SIMPLIFY_DISABLED=1 always bypasses.

hardVerbs.description: Verbs that get the shipping reminder (the stronger wording); the prompt is never blocked

workflowArtifactGate.description: Review artifact gate settings for fix and cook.

enabled.description: Runtime toggle for the workflow artifact gate after the hook itself is enabled.

softStages.description: Stages that warn when proof is missing.

hardStages.description: Stages that block when artifacts fail validation.

highRiskAutoStop.description: Require human approval for high-risk auto-mode workflows.

secrets.description: Ask before committing secret files (.env, private keys) or lines matching known credential formats. Mark a known-fake line with adf-allow-secret.

allowSecretFiles.description: Repo-relative globs (same syntax as git.directPush.paths) of files the secret scan skips, names and lines, e.g. test fixtures with fake keys. Only a person adds entries.

messageFormat.description: Deprecated: use git.enforcement. When set, true denies and false skips commit messages that are not conventional commits or carry an AI attribution line; when unset, the check follows git.enforcement.

types.description: Allowed conventional-commit types (default: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert).

agentsMd.description: ADF's block in the project's AGENTS.md (read by Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini and other agents). The installer adds and refreshes it on every run.

block.description: false: install.sh adds no ADF block to AGENTS.md and removes one from an earlier install. Committed with the config, so every clone behaves alike.

git.description: Git workflow for this project, enforced by the commit-guard and git-flow-guard hooks, .claude/skills/git/scripts/git-flow.cjs and the CI guards. The process itself is written in docs/conventions/git-workflow.md.

flow.description: release-train: feat/fix squash into the open release/x.y.z, which merges into main; trunk: feat/fix squash into main; off: no branch-model checks (commit format, bulk add, secrets and force-push rules still apply).

enforcement.description: What the hooks do on a workflow violation: off = allow silently, ask = ask the user, deny = block. Secrets always ask; force-pushing a protected branch is always denied.

versionFiles.description: Files that carry the version. Each is a JSON file with a dot path ({"path": "package.json", "json": "version"}) or a text file with a regex whose first group is the version ({"path": "pyproject.toml", "regex": "^version = \"(.*)\""}).

paths.description: Globs that a chore commit may push straight to the main branch (** crosses folders).

pathTypes.description: Path prefix -> commit types allowed for staged files under it, e.g. {".claude/": ["feat", "fix", "perf"]}.

commands.description: Extra regular expressions for Bash commands that count as verification (in addition to common test, lint, typecheck and build commands).

lintOnEdit.description: lint-on-edit settings. Uses the project linter only (Biome or ESLint from node_modules, Ruff from .venv or PATH); reports problems, never rewrites files.

enabled.description: Opt-in: lint each edited file and wake Claude when problems are found.

types.description: Notification types to show (default: permission_prompt, idle_prompt, elicitation_dialog, agent_needs_input).
